WITH filtered_months AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
      AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
      AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
      AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
      AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')
),
sales_by_month AS (
    SELECT f_items.i_manager_id, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_items f_items ON ss.ss_item_sk = f_items.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_months f_months ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = f_months.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY f_items.i_manager_id, f_months.d_moy
),
manager_averages AS (
    SELECT s.i_manager_id, AVG(s.sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM sales_by_month s
    GROUP BY s.i_manager_id
)
SELECT s.i_manager_id, s.sum_sales, a.avg_monthly_sales
FROM sales_by_month s
JOIN manager_averages a ON s.i_manager_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.i_manager_id
WHERE CASE WHEN a.avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(s.sum_sales - a.avg_monthly_sales) / a.avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY s.i_manager_id, a.avg_monthly_sales, s.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
